verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI reply drafting, let alone drafting in the user's own voice and tone. The Graph API's ability to 'Draft, read, reply' is a developer building block, not AI-generated replies. The single community mention of 'Copilot integration' in Outlook does not describe voice-matched reply drafting, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
